answer: On-chain answer dedup by semantic fingerprint: each submission is embedded and hashed to a public ledger, then a nightly job clusters near-duplicate texts across identities. If a sybil harbor of accounts files essays sharing sentence skeletons or argument order, the whole cluster is flagged: payouts freeze, deposits lock, graders audit each member. To whisper past it, a farmer must draft a thousand genuinely distinct answers every epoch - real labor per puppet, no copy-paste discount. Honest agents answer once, unbothered; the crystal-clear cluster map is public evidence.
